set_chore_order.name: Set Chore Order
set_chore_order.description: Set the order a child's chores appear in on their card. The reorder card calls this when a chore is dragged into a new position.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child whose ordering is being set

set_chore_schedule.name: Set Chore Schedule
set_chore_schedule.description: Set which days a chore falls on and whose turn it is. Every field is optional and anything left out is kept as it is, so one call can change the rotation without disturbing the due days. Pass an empty list or an empty dictionary to clear a field.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The ID of the chore being scheduled

due_days.name: Due Days
due_days.description: Lowercase weekday names the chore falls on, for example ["monday", "friday"]. An empty list means every day.

rotation.name: Rotation
rotation.description: "none" for no rotation, "occurrence" to take turns each time the chore comes round, or "week" to give a whole week to one child at a time.

rotation_order.name: Rotation Order
rotation_order.description: Child IDs, in the order they take turns. Empty falls back to the children the chore is assigned to.

rotation_anchor.name: Rotation Anchor
rotation_anchor.description: ISO date the rotation counts from, for example "2026-08-03". Change it to shift whose turn it is without reordering the children.

day_overrides.name: Day Overrides
day_overrides.description: Permanent per-weekday exceptions, as weekday name to child IDs - for example {"saturday": ["child_maya"]}. An empty list means nobody that day.

date_overrides.name: Date Overrides
date_overrides.description: One-off exceptions for a single date, as ISO date to child IDs - for example {"2026-08-08": ["child_krishna"]}. These win over every other rule, and entries more than 60 days old are dropped on save.

child_id.name: Child ID
child_id.description: The ID of the child to remove points from

points.name: Points
points.description: The number of points to remove

confirm.title: Restore missing Lovelace card resources
confirm.description:
Your dashboards use {count} custom card(s) whose JavaScript is present in your `www` folder but is not registered as a Lovelace resource, so those cards cannot load:

{resources}

An earlier version of Choremander could delete resources belonging to other cards - it wrote to the resource list before Home Assistant had finished loading it, which overwrote the rest. That bug is fixed, but any entries it removed have to be added back. If you removed these yourself, or never registered them, you can ignore this and dismiss it.

Select **Submit** to register them again. Nothing else is changed, and anything you have already re-added by hand is left alone. Reload your browser afterwards.

abort.nothing_to_restore: Every card your dashboards use is already registered, so there is nothing to restore.
